details: Bitcoin surged above $67,000, and the total cryptocurrency market capitalization increased to $2.37 trillion, following reports that the United States and Iran signed a peace agreement. This geopolitical development also saw Ethereum gain over 10% and triggered approximately $198 million in short liquidations across the market.
title: Bitcoin Breaks $67K as US-Iran Peace Deal Spurs Market Rally

details: XRP has experienced a significant rebound, with data indicating that wallets holding at least one million XRP now control a substantial 74.1% of its circulating supply. This suggests strong whale accumulation. The cryptocurrency is currently testing the $1.30 resistance level, and an improving macro backdrop is contributing to its upward momentum.
title: XRP Price Eyes $1.30 as Whale Accumulation Fuels Rebound

details: Zcash (ZEC) saw a rapid 17% surge in its price after successfully implementing an emergency hard fork to patch a critical counterfeiting vulnerability in its Orchard shielded pool. This swift resolution, which added over $1 billion to its market capitalization, also led to more than $13 million in short liquidations.
title: Zcash (ZEC) Jumps 17% Following Emergency Vulnerability Fix

details: Lido's Total Value Locked (TVL) has increased by 10.03% over the past 24 hours, reaching $16.328 billion. This significant rise positions Lido as the fourth-ranked protocol in DeFiLlama's TVL rankings and indicates growing confidence and activity in the liquid staking sector.
title: Lido Protocol's TVL Jumps 10% in 24 Hours
